---
title: "xurnm"
---

## Description

Rename all variables in the dataset.

## Parameters

**`inds`**

: Name of the input dataset

  *Required:* Yes

**`mode`**

: Mode: add/remove. Choose whether to add prefix or remove some characters

  *Required:* Yes

**`prefix`**

: Characters to add before variable name (Optional, used with mode=add)

**`rchar`**

: Number of characters to remove from the beginning of variable name (Optional, used with mode=remove)

**`debug`**

: Flag that determines whether to delete temporary datasets or not

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`

## Examples

```sas
%xurnm(ds,mode=add,prefix=_);
%xurnm(ds,mode=remove,rchar=2);
```
